column1: # W55: behavioral A/B for the single-step NCR current-frame pass.
# WHY. Every main-table TRACE anchor passes GEOPACT_CRS=1, but no single-step
# run.log anywhere contains the pass's audit keys (crs_g etc.), so logs cannot
# distinguish "audit not printed" from "pass bypassed on the v3_nap path". If
# the pass is bypassed, the single-step main numbers are behaviorally LIP+NEO
# and the rho_cov dose claims (56.45 -> 73.90) rest on a stale lineage.
# DESIGN. Clone the two single-step anchors verbatim and toggle ONLY
# GEOPACT_CRS. LIMIT=400 for speed. Read accuracy plus the per-sample
# keep_local_hash stream: identical hashes across the pair = pass bypassed,
# diverging hashes = pass live (and the accuracy gap should point toward the
# published dose-curve gap of ~17 points on SSv2).
